# The Autonomous

> AI agents for every role in your company.

The Autonomous is an AI platform that gives businesses an AI workforce. Users enter their company website, get personalized AI agent recommendations, and launch agents that start working immediately — researching prospects, auditing SEO, analyzing competitors — before users even ask.

## Key Facts

- 14 AI agent roles: Sales, Marketing, Accounting, Strategy, Product, Front-End Engineering, Back-End Engineering, AI Expert, Admin, HR, Finance, Customer Success, Legal, Data Analyst
- 168 role-specific skills and 112 system capabilities
- Agents work proactively (not just when asked)
- Persistent memory across conversations
- Inter-agent collaboration via @mentions
- Tool integrations: Apollo.io (210M+ contacts), Instantly.ai (email campaigns), Web Search
- Credits-based pricing: 1000 free credits on signup (~20 conversations)
- Custom agent builder for unique business roles
- Self-serve REST API for programmatic access
- Built by Chainflux

## Target Market

Traditional small businesses getting into AI for the first time — not AI-native companies. The platform is designed so non-technical business owners can get AI agents working for their company in 2 minutes.

## How It Works

1. User enters their company website URL
2. AI analyzes the business (industry, size, workflows)
3. Platform recommends which agents would have highest impact
4. User selects and launches agents
5. Agents start working proactively with role-specific tasks
6. User chats with agents via web dashboard, WhatsApp, or Telegram

## Pricing

- Free: 1000 credits (~20 conversations)
- Top-up: 500 credits / $5, 2000 credits / $15, 5000 credits / $30
